summary.text: Nathan Biah is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 3 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since January 5, 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Nathan Biah lives in Providence, Rhode Island.
He earned a degree in criminal justice from Rhode Island College in 1999 and a master's degree in education administration from the University of Rhode Island in 2007.
His career experience includes working as a math teacher and as the principal at Dr. Jorge Alvarez High School.
In the 2021-2022 legislative session he was assigned to the House Education Committee.
